title: Submerged Railway [Pokopia Build]
creator: 귀월 Gwiwol
summary: A dreamy flooded rail station where a train glides across submerged tracks toward a tiny platform, framed by utility poles, lantern light, and soft waterfront planting.
publicNotes:
## Build notes

This frame sells the build immediately: the train is centered at the end of a waterlogged rail line, with the track disappearing under a turquoise surface instead of sitting on dry ground. The utility poles and overhead wire make the route feel functional, while the warm sunset haze turns the flooded scene into something gentle rather than abandoned.

The platform details do a lot of quiet work. A bicycle, mailbox, glowing lamp, pale paving, and flowered hedges make the stop feel like a place someone uses every day. The best reference idea here is the contrast between heavy transit infrastructure and soft shoreline decoration.
